next.reason: 1985: in a format 2 (level 02-48 group) entry 'data-name-1 is optional. If present it may be used only to qualify a sum counter reference.' The 2023 format §2023:13.15.2 keeps the entry-name clause optional. §2023:13.15.3 SR7 allows the data-name only in GENERATE, USE BEFORE REPORTING, 'as a qualifier for a SUM counter', in UPON, or as a SUM operand, and 'The data-name shall not be referenced in any other way.' GENERATE, USE and UPON name report groups with a TYPE clause, which §2023:13.15.3 SR5 confines to level 1; a SUM operand 'shall be the name of a numeric data item' (§2023:13.18.54.3 SR4), which a group entry is not. So for a level 02-48 group entry only qualification remains: the same programs are accepted and refused.
